newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby Union-Queensland stun New South Wales.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union-Queensland stun New South Wales.

text.p: Struggling Queensland upset the form book and badly dented New South Wales' semifinal hopes with a committed 26-16 win in the Super 12 competition on Saturday. Queensland, who went into the game languishing at the bottom of the table with only one victory to their credit, scored three tries to one in a spirited encounter at the Sydney Football Stadium between Australia's two traditional provincial powers. The visitors gave an inspired defensive display to silence a partisan home crowd of 30,106, New South Wales' highest attendance of the season.
